study: Moving Average 1.00 MetaQuotes shift6 reference vs structure, liquidity sweep, volatility expansion
true_ema_note: Not EMA: official example uses SIMPLE MA period12 shift6 on close, iMA(...,12,6,MODE_SMA,PRICE_CLOSE) via CopyBuffer from index 0. Shift6 affects chart position of buffer. The earlier Nexus v1.10 used open+last 11 closes and was NOT equivalent.
official_position_sizing_not_reproduced: MetaQuotes EA dynamically sizes lot by available margin and DecreaseFactor history, so actual dollars from MT5 are NOT recreated. Simulated one unit of underlying price (not cash).

entry_models.A_METAQUOTES_NO_SL: Original shift6 MA candle prior OPEN/CLOSE cross, opposite MA cross exit, NO protective SL, original sample direction, quarter end flattened for measurement
entry_models.A_MA12_ATR_STOP: Exact same shift6 MA entry, opposite cross exit, 1xATR14 initial protective stop
entry_models.B_MA12_STRUCTURE_BREAK: Same shift6 MA crossover + prior 12 completed candle high/low broken, 0.03ATR buffer and 0.18 candle body; 1ATR SL
entry_models.C_SWEEP_CONFIRM: Sweep of previously closed 14-bar extrema, return inside and confirmation candle beyond sweep midpoint, 1ATR SL, exits opposite original shifted MA cross
entry_models.D_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION: Previous candle directional breakout >1.45ATR, body >0.48, EMA12/55 and ATR14/50 ratio, 1ATR SL, exits opposite original shifted MA cross

historical_sources: Pinned 2024/2025 XAUUSD 1min OHLCV Git commit b2cfdc571ffac9eff9f2132ea6946da559d29af2 (public repository parshant65-lang)
execution: Signals computed from closed candles and source shifted MA observable at bar open, enter at next open; stop-first OHLC and adverse gaps; no actual bid/ask, commissions/swap and real fills; positions never overlap; quarter ends flattened so no carry to next quarter

results_summary.strongest_observation: Only original MetaQuotes without SL on M30 positive 2025 and partial 2026, BUT negative 2024 and risk issue; no safe conclusion.

quality_and_limits: 2025/2026 partial were repeatedly studied and are not untouched OOS, 2024 historical test outside 2025/26 design but is retrospective, no forward account results.
MetaQuotes official dynamic lot/money management is NOT modeled and original $3k result from user's MT5 is not reproducible from these price points.
No real broker tick and bid/ask executions; each point is hypothetical $0.01/oz movement, not account USD.
No dynamically observed spread, slippage, swap, commission, market depth, contract sizes or real max intratrade DD.
Annual PF recomputed by summing underlying positive/negative price contributions, not by averaging quarterly PF.
No new entry variant passed strict predeclared screen; all negative and mixed trials retained.
Original approved MA EA v1.10 and all 12 existing research candidates remain untouched.
R for A_METAQUOTES_NO_SL is normalized by hypothetical ATR only; because no actual stop it is NOT a true 1R capped risk measure.
